verdict.rationale: Speechmatics offers batch jobs, so the story applies, but no evidence item documents attaching custom identifiers or metadata to a job. Nothing shows such data coming back in results or webhook payloads. The closest items cover batch processing, job deletion and per-project usage tracking, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach my own identifiers or metadata to a job and get them back in results and webhook payloads
